column7: ADR-112 §4: admin validate --posture on the config a fresh keyorix-server admin init writes (then encryption init, migrate) prints "No deviations found." and exits 0; init generates the self-signed TLS cert/key and the metrics token file it references at 0600 without printing them, and the server boots on it (TLS with the generated cert, /metrics 401 without the token, 200 with it). The relaxed admin init --dev config is labelled DEV-ONLY and fails the same check (TestAdminInitDev_IsLabelledAndFailsSecureBaselinePosture); an existing config is never changed (TestAdminInit_ExistingConfigIsNotChanged). SECURE-DEFAULT-1
